description: This source file defines a class `VoiceWakeTester` used for testing voice activation detection features on macOS. It manages speech recognition, audio input, state handling, and debugging utilities. It leverages Apple's Speech and AVFoundation frameworks to process live audio, recognize speech, and detect trigger words or phrases.

classes.name: VoiceWakeTester
classes.description: Main class responsible for managing speech recognition, microphone input, and triggers for voice wake testing.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Sets up and starts the speech recognition engine, handling permissions and configuration, and begins listening for voice triggers.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the speech recognition and audio engine, canceling ongoing tasks.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Ends the recognition gracefully with a timeout, then stops the engine.

methods.name: handleResult
methods.description: Processes recognition results, detects triggers, manages state transitions, and handles errors.

methods.name: scheduleSilenceCheck
methods.description: Schedules a task to detect silence and triggers fallback detection if no speech is heard.

methods.name: holdUntilSilence
methods.description: Holds listening state until silence is detected or timeout occurs.

methods.name: configureSession
methods.description: Configures audio input session, placeholder in current implementation.

methods.name: logInputSelection
methods.description: Logs the preferred microphone input source.

methods.name: ensurePermissions
methods.description: Checks and requests necessary permissions for speech recognition and microphone access.
